note: Private campground on 59 acres on Route 5 just south of Ascutney (I-91 exit 8), below Mount Ascutney; the Connecticut River lies east across Route 5 and the rail line. Heated pool, rec room and a fishing pond. A mix of seasonal trailers and nightly sites; the website posts no rates, so call for a price. --Claude
summary: One-page operator site read: 100 sites incl. large pull-throughs with full hookups and 50 A; pool, store, rec room, laundry, showers; open 5/1-10/25 - derived values confirmed to manual (shower added). No posted rate (RV Life $$ tier stands in; no gateway within 40 km; not a Good Sam park). Google 4.0 (89). Seasonal share notable but not a majority on imagery (~18 units in place a week before opening). Not waterfront confirmed. Phone and website unchanged.
flags: PRICE GATE: no rate on the operator's site (one page, 'Telephone: (802) 674-2812'); no booking engine; RoverPass listing unclaimed (not a channel). RV Life tier $$ (stored) is the price signal. gateways.py: none within 40 km (nearest Lake George 105 km). Not in the Good Sam directory as a GS Park.

GOOGLE: 4.0 (89 reviews), phone +1 802-674-2812 matches, website matches. Exactly 4.0, not under. Reviews read (Google's default order): 'Been seasonals for 17 years, Love it here' (3 weeks ago); 'I am a seasonal camper here. I'm a traveling medical assistant' (a year ago); 'I strongly urge anyone considering Getaway Mountain Campground to stay far away ... the owners were extremely rude and unwelcoming' (2 years ago); 'We are RVrs that have traveled extensively ... one of the prettiest campsites' (3 years ago). RV Life 4* (stored).

LONG-STAY (read as mixed, NOT mostly seasonal; borderline-iffy only on the missing rate): the operator markets nothing seasonal on its page (it leads with pull-through full-hookup sites and activities: bonfires, pot lucks, bingo, wagon rides). Esri imagery of 2024-04-23, a week before the 5/1 opening, shows roughly 18 trailers/units left in place under partial canopy in the wooded north-west part of the park (~43.3880,-72.4140) against an advertised 100 sites, while the open field by the office and pool is empty - so the nightly share looks well over half, though canopy may hide more units. Test 2 (no posted nightly rate) would only bite if the reviewer reads it as long-stay in character; two of the four reviews read are seasonal campers.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the Connecticut River is ~100-150 m east of the office across US 5 and the rail line (Esri); the sites lie west of US 5 in the woods.
PIN: 43.38661,-72.41202 is at the entrance/office off US 5; the site area runs ~100-250 m north-west. Fine (no move over 250 m).

INCLUSION EVIDENCE: still cites 'nightly $45' from RoverPass/RV Life; the operator posts no rate. Proposed replacement: 'getawaymountaincampground.com (live 2026-11-16, phone 802-674-2812): 100-site campground with large pull-through full-hookup 50 A sites, open 5/1-10/25; no posted rate, RV Life 4* $$; Google 4.0 (89) -> real RV campground'.
